# BatchSWMM56

> Batch runner for EPA SWMM5, SWMM6 and other SWMM engines. Upload one or more SWMM .inp models, run them
> through an EPA SWMM engine (native executable, SWMM5 shared-library API, or an
> in-browser WebAssembly build of SWMM5 / OpenSWMM "SWMM6" 5.3), and inspect
> report summaries, time-series graphs, and continuity errors for each file.

## For browser agents (UI automation)

All key controls carry stable `data-testid` attributes:

- Upload: `card-upload-zone`, `button-browse-files`, `input-file` (hidden file input, accepts .inp)
- Sample models: `select-sample-model` (dropdown; selecting an option loads it immediately), `option-sample-<Name.inp>`, `button-load-samples` (Load All)
- Engine mode: `button-mode-executable`, `button-mode-api`, `button-mode-wasm`, `button-mode-wasm6`, `button-mode-wasm6dev`
- Run: `button-start-processing`, cancel: `button-cancel-processing`, reset: `button-reset`
- Result tabs (per file): `tab-report-inp-*`, RPT Text, RPT Graphs, Key Charts, RPT Histograms, RPT HTML, AI Report
- Exports: `button-export-csv`, `button-export-excel`, `button-export-pdf`, `button-download-report-*`

Deep links (query params on `/`):

- `?engine=executable|api|wasm|wasm6|wasm6dev` — preselect the engine mode
- `?sample=Demo_extran2.inp` — auto-load a sample model (comma-separate for several)
- Example: `/?engine=wasm6&sample=Demo_extran2.inp,Demo_exam1.inp`

Note: the `wasm`, `wasm6`, and `wasm6dev` engines run entirely in the browser page; the batch
HTTP API below only covers the server-side `executable` and `api` engine modes.

## HTTP API (server-side runs)

- `GET /api/samples` — list bundled sample models `[{name, size, title}]`
- `GET /api/samples/{filename}` — fetch a sample .inp file's text
- `POST /api/upload` — multipart/form-data, repeated `files` field, .inp only
  (max 100 files, 25 MB each). Returns a batch job object with `id`.
- `POST /api/batch/{jobId}/start` — JSON body: `{engineMode?: "executable"|"api",
  timeoutMinutes?, stopOnError?, overrides?: {reportStepMinutes?, flowRouting?:
  "steady"|"kinematic"|"dynamic", startDate?: "YYYY-MM-DD", endDate?,
  routingStepSeconds?}}`. Starts processing asynchronously.
- `GET /api/batch/{jobId}` — poll job status; the finished job JSON embeds each
  file's result summary (metrics, status, `hasReport`/`hasInp` flags).
- `GET /api/batch/{jobId}/results/{resultId}/content` — fetch a result's full
  report and input text: `{reportContent, inpContent}`.
- `POST /api/batch/{jobId}/cancel` — cancel a running batch
- `DELETE /api/batch/{jobId}` — delete a non-running batch
- `GET /api/jobs/latest` — latest completed batch job
- `GET /api/swmm-status` — which engines are available on the server
- `WS /api/ws?jobId={jobId}` — live progress/result event stream (alternative to polling)

Typical automated run: POST /api/upload → POST /api/batch/{id}/start → poll
GET /api/batch/{id} until `status` is `completed` → read per-file summaries from
the job JSON and fetch full report text via the `/content` endpoint as needed.
Note: jobs are tied to the browser session (cookie) that uploaded them and are
deleted after 24 hours.
